answer: Each identity locks 26 POA for 18 epochs and signs 10 beacon-timed receipts. A whisper committee of 9 auditors replays 6 samples. Shared funding or hosts form one island cluster; member k owes 26*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 26*(2*k-1). The velvet ledger rejects reused work; two failures burn all cluster bonds and bar its keys for 15 epochs.
